glyph_rationales.0: the first station of the record's own movement path: ground before any move.

glyph_rationales.8: the eighth station of the record's own movement path.
glyph_rationales.the joint: the joint — the pivot where motion actually lives; articulation is a joint moved, not a part described.
glyph_rationales.the bearing: the bearing — the round seat a turning part rides in; freedom held inside a fit.
glyph_rationales.the driver: the driver — the small mover that hands its motion to the next part.
glyph_rationales.the link: the link — the connection between members — the living articulation of the whole.
glyph_rationales.the stock: the stock — the fitted body of a part; the machined block the motion works through.
glyph_rationales.the lever: the lever — the angled member that turns force into work.
glyph_rationales.the machine bed: the machine bed — the level surface every moving part is mounted to.
glyph_rationales.5→0: the path's own completion sign: the last move returns into the first.
glyph_rationales.→: the move itself: one term passing into the next, continuity drawn as an arrow of motion.
glyph_rationales.∴: therefore: the record's claim standing after its own reasons.
glyph_rationales.×: the crossing: one encounter meeting another without either dissolving.
glyph_rationales.Ω: the closing term: the path arrived at its end, which is its ground.
